column1: # module_classes.tsv — THE ONE AUTHORITATIVE MODULE CLASSIFICATION of the
# package (pure data; ar5-manifest slice, 2026-09-04 — the external audit's
# Finding 2 asked for one classification consumed by every instrument).
# Consumed by: scripts/capability_manifest.lean (consumer set = the modules
# whose proof cones count as "a client consumes this rule"),
# scripts/boundary_check.sh (the negative architectural check: which modules
# must not mention logic internals; which are exempt by class) — all three
# fail hard on a class outside the vocabulary, on a listed module absent from
# the built environment, and (the Lean scripts) on a package module absent
# from this list. Columns are TAB-separated: module, class, internals-allow,
# note. `internals-allow` is `-` or the reason a module's CURRENT mentions of
# logic internals are tolerated by the boundary check (per module; the check
# prints the entry as ALLOWLISTED and warns when an entry has no hits left).
#   core                 the logic and its certification: semantics -> heap -> rules -> adequacy (the import-direction check's protected set)
#   production-core      the production lanes (driver collapse into the shipped pipeline); clients of adequacy, imported by production wrappers
#   positive-client      a program proof through the PUBLIC rules only; manifest consumer; boundary check applies
#   declared-smoke       a structurally-forcing smoke of a public surface, through the public rules only; manifest consumer; boundary check applies
#   semantic-test        regression witnesses proved directly against `Step`/the engine round; NOT a consumer; boundary check exempt by class

#   engine-mirror-test   generated-engine round = mirror step witnesses as a module of their own; NOT a consumer; exempt (vocabulary reserved; currently no member — MirrorCoverage holds its `engine_step_matchU` instances beside the `Step` witnesses and is classified by its header as semantic-test)

#   production-wrapper   a module whose rule use is ONLY through the imported clients it wraps (the operative criterion — NOT "carries closed statements over the shipped pipeline": four positive clients carry `*_certified_production` too, AR5 range audit H-3); NOT a consumer; exempt (it names the driver lane by design)
#   negative-test        an unprovability result exhibited through the engine's actual behaviour; NOT a consumer; exempt (its header states the `Step` exception)
#   example-support      layout constants and canned shapes; NOT a consumer; boundary check applies
